record.source_closeout_reference: Authored during the mission in the Claude Code session executing the sponsor-approved long-running-mission gap plan; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Define the advisory mission-health vocabulary (budget_burn, objective_value, confidence, drift, risk, continuation_judgment) with grounding rules and a worked example, fulfilling the V3-ANCHOR-007 named gate of vocabulary before schema, validator, or gate proposals.

envelope.reference: Sponsor agreement with the five-gap analysis and instruction to address the gaps in sequence starting with the next three or four bounded missions
envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no schema files or required checkpoint fields
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the vocabulary doc, registry row, and README bullet
any wording implies thresholds, gates, or required fields are approved
a signal definition relies on model-estimated time as measurement
verification reports an unresolved advisory finding

verification.summary: Advisory lint, NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks passed on the first run after the edits; mission-record lint run after this record was authored.

notes: Docs-only vocabulary with no new dependencies, schema, or code paths.
Grounding rules tie every signal to artifact evidence and explicitly ban model-estimated minutes, carrying the POC 012/013 measurement lesson forward.
The worked example is labeled synthetic to avoid being read as real run evidence.
Scope stayed inside the vocabulary doc, registry row, and README bullet.
No thresholds, gates, or required fields were added.

friction_notes: The signal/judgment consistency rule (rule 5) is checkable by a future advisory validator, but adding it now would have exceeded mission scope; it is a named follow-up.
Six signals may prove too many to record honestly at every checkpoint; ladder evidence should test whether a smaller core set suffices.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Anti-theater grounding rules matter more than the signal list itself; a vocabulary without citation requirements would invite checkpoint theater.
continuation_judgment as a closed five-value set maps cleanly onto the candidate profile's continue/ask/safe-hold/halt mechanics.
Ladder evidence should measure per-checkpoint recording cost to validate or shrink the signal set.
